biography: Ricky Stenhouse Jr. hails from Olive Branch, Mississippi, a town steeped in stock car tradition. His father, Ricky Stenhouse Sr., was a local legend on the dirt tracks, and young Ricky practically grew up in the garage, wrenching on engines and dreaming of asphalt glory. He started racing go-karts at age six, quickly displaying a fearlessness that bordered on recklessness. One defining moment came at a local dirt track race when he was 16. Down two laps after a spin, he relentlessly charged through the field, bumping and grinding his way to a stunning victory, earning him the nickname 'The Mississippi Missile'. Now, at 23, Ricky is making waves in the Stock USA Gen3 series, known for his aggressive driving style and unwillingness to back down from a challenge. While still honing his skills and seeking consistency, his raw talent and unwavering determination make him a driver to watch.
drivingStyle: Ricky Stenhouse Jr.'s driving style is characterized by relentless aggression and a 'no-holds-barred' approach. He attacks corners with a ferocious entry speed, often flirting with the edge of control. Tire management isn't exactly his forte; he tends to burn through rubber quickly due to his hard-charging nature. Under pressure, Ricky thrives; he becomes even more assertive, taking calculated risks that often pay off, but occasionally lead to spectacular wrecks. His motto seems to be: 'Go hard or go home'.

rivalries.name: Jake 'The Snake' Olson
rivalries.reason: A veteran driver who publicly criticized Ricky's aggressive style, leading to several on-track altercations.

rivalries.name: Ava 'Hurricane' Hernandez
rivalries.reason: A rising female star known for her cool and calculated approach, a stark contrast to Ricky's wild style, creating a natural rivalry.

rivalries.name: Blake 'The Professor' Peterson
rivalries.reason: Blake and Ricky traded paint and words after a controversial pass for the lead at Talladega, igniting a heated battle.

quirks: Always wears the same faded Lynyrd Skynyrd t-shirt under his fire suit.
Sharpens his pencil to a needle point before every race, claiming it helps him focus.
Listens to a recording of his father's pre-race pep talk before strapping into the car.
famousQuote: "I ain't here to make friends, I'm here to win races. If you don't like it, get out of my way."
careerHighlight: Winning the Snowball Derby at Five Flags Speedway in 2021, a legendary short track race, after starting from the back of the pack due to a pre-race penalty.
careerLowPoint: Flipping his car five times at Daytona in 2022 after a late-race collision, resulting in a DNF and a trip to the infield care center.
